answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit tied to one public work history. Like a comet leaving a traceable tail, each identity builds a record of jobs done, and a newcomer with no history may only take tiny tasks. Spinning up a hundred fakes means locking a hundred deposits and building a hundred histories from scratch, while a zephyr of cheap sockpuppets earns nothing until each has done real work. Identities sharing one behavioral fingerprint are flagged as a single violet-marked cluster and slashed together, so attacker cost grows with every fake while an honest agent pays once.
